scientific_integrity: All-order analytic proof with independently programmed finite exact checks; no independent external certification. The 2019-07-04 primary anchor is the earliest public posting of the motivating random-sequential-adsorption source; older matching literature is supporting foundational context.
scientific_limitations: Applies to independent random edge priorities on cycles and wheels under a shared-edge coupling, and gives a limit rather than finite-size equality. The one-dimensional density is classical. Historical priority still has full-text access gaps.
title: A Bernoulli hub gain for edge-greedy dimer matching on growing wheels
